modeling_notes.advanced_method: Rolling corrective dispatch with renewable uncertainty and battery realism.

notation_and_constraints.name: Actual renewable availability
notation_and_constraints.text: The advanced scheduler observes actual renewable availability, which may differ from forecast.

notation_and_constraints.name: Battery throughput limit
notation_and_constraints.text: Daily battery usage is limited by a throughput budget.

notation_and_constraints.name: Rolling update
notation_and_constraints.text: Every 3 hours, actual renewable data is observed and energy dispatch is corrected.
notation_and_constraints.formula: k^adv_{j,i,t} can be redistributed, but hard-deadline x_{j,t} is fixed.

notation_and_constraints.name: Hard-deadline schedule preservation
notation_and_constraints.text: Periodic jobs and accepted sporadic jobs are not moved after Level 1 acceptance.
notation_and_constraints.formula: x^adv_{j,t}=x^L1_{j,t}, for all j in J_p union accepted(J_s)

notation_and_constraints.name: Renewable surplus charging
notation_and_constraints.text: Renewable surplus is used to charge batteries before it is sold.

notation_and_constraints.name: Renewable shortage correction
notation_and_constraints.text: When actual renewable energy is insufficient, battery discharge can compensate before thermal slack is used.

notation_and_constraints.name: Market-aware battery dispatch
notation_and_constraints.text: Battery charging is preferred at low prices or renewable-surplus hours; discharging is preferred at high prices.
notation_and_constraints.formula: Chg_{b,t}>0 only if lambda_t<=lambda_low or Surplus^R_t>0; Dis_{b,t}>0 only if lambda_t>=lambda_high

notation_and_constraints.name: Aperiodic soft-deadline policy
notation_and_constraints.text: Aperiodic jobs do not receive hard-deadline acceptance tests; late completion is recorded as soft miss and tardiness.
notation_and_constraints.formula: T_j=max(0,C_j-d_j), Miss_j=1 if C_j>d_j for j in J_a

notation_and_constraints.name: Advanced objective
notation_and_constraints.text: The objective includes aperiodic misses, thermal cost, battery aging, and market revenue.
